answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 11377 Country: India Title: kya 'arham' naam rakhna najaaiz hai? Question: kya 'arham' naam rakhna najaaiz hai? Answer ID: 11377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 494/494=M/1430) Naming with ?Arham? is allowed, but instead it is better to keep the name as: Abdur Rahim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
